qe: Choose the correct completion: “Hardly had the train left ___ the passengers reached the platform.”
qh: सही शब्द चुनिए: “Hardly had the train left ___ the passengers reached the platform.”
e: The standard correlative construction is “hardly … when.”
eh: मानक युग्म “hardly … when” है।

qe: Which sentence correctly expresses a third conditional?
qh: कौन-सा वाक्य third conditional को सही रूप में व्यक्त करता है?
o: If I had known, I would have helped.
If I knew, I will help.
If I know, I would helped.
If I had know, I helped.
If I would know, I had helped.
oh: If I had known, I would have helped.
If I knew, I will help.
If I know, I would helped.
If I had know, I helped.
If I would know, I had helped.
e: A third conditional uses past perfect in the if-clause and “would have” + past participle in the result clause.
eh: Third conditional में if-clause में past perfect और परिणाम वाले उपवाक्य में “would have” + past participle आता है।
oe: If I had known, I would have helped.
If I knew, I will help.
If I know, I would helped.
If I had know, I helped.
If I would know, I had helped.

qe: Choose the correct agreement: “Neither of the two proposals ___ acceptable.”
qh: सही क्रिया-रूप चुनिए: “Neither of the two proposals ___ acceptable.”
e: “Neither” is singular in formal standard usage, so it takes “is.”
eh: मानक औपचारिक प्रयोग में “Neither” एकवचन है, इसलिए इसके साथ “is” आता है।

qe: What is the function of the underlined clause in “I know where she lives”?
qh: “I know where she lives” में “where she lives” उपवाक्य का कार्य क्या है?
o: Noun clause functioning as the object of “know”
oh: “know” के कर्म के रूप में प्रयुक्त संज्ञा उपवाक्य
“I” की विशेषता बताने वाला विशेषण उपवाक्य
e: “Where she lives” answers “what do I know?” and functions as the object of “know,” so it is a noun clause.
eh: “Where she lives” प्रश्न “मैं क्या जानता हूँ?” का उत्तर देता है और “know” का कर्म है; इसलिए यह संज्ञा उपवाक्य है।
oe: Noun clause functioning as the object of “know”

qe: Which figure of speech is used in “The classroom was a zoo after the bell”?
qh: “The classroom was a zoo after the bell” में कौन-सा figure of speech है?
e: The classroom is directly described as a zoo without “like” or “as,” making it a metaphor.
eh: कक्षा को “like” या “as” के बिना सीधे चिड़ियाघर कहा गया है, इसलिए यह रूपक है।

qe: Choose the correct sentence using a gerund after a preposition.
qh: preposition के बाद gerund का सही प्रयोग वाला वाक्य चुनिए।
o: She is interested in learning Sanskrit.
She is interested in learn Sanskrit.
She is interested to learning Sanskrit.
She is interested for learn Sanskrit.
oh: She is interested in learning Sanskrit.
She is interested in learn Sanskrit.
She is interested to learning Sanskrit.
She is interested for learn Sanskrit.
e: A verb following the preposition “in” takes the -ing form: “in learning.”
eh: “In” preposition के बाद आने वाली क्रिया -ing रूप में होती है: “in learning।”
oe: She is interested in learning Sanskrit.
She is interested in learn Sanskrit.
She is interested to learning Sanskrit.
She is interested for learn Sanskrit.

qe: Which word is the antonym of “transient”?
qh: “Transient” का विलोम कौन-सा है?
e: “Transient” means temporary or short-lived; “permanent” is its opposite.
eh: “Transient” का अर्थ अस्थायी या अल्पकालिक है; इसका विलोम “permanent” है।

qe: Choose the correctly punctuated direct speech.
qh: प्रत्यक्ष कथन में सही विराम-चिह्न वाला विकल्प चुनिए।
o: Ravi said, I will return tomorrow.
oh: Ravi said, I will return tomorrow.
e: A reporting clause is followed by a comma, and the quoted sentence begins and ends with quotation marks; the full stop belongs inside the closing quotation mark in this style.
eh: कथन से पहले comma आता है और उद्धृत वाक्य quotation marks में रखा जाता है; इस शैली में पूर्ण विराम अंतिम उद्धरण-चिह्न के भीतर आता है।
oe: Ravi said, I will return tomorrow.

qe: In “The committee has published its report,” why is “has” acceptable?
qh: “The committee has published its report” में “has” क्यों सही है?
o: The collective noun is treated as a single body
The tense requires a plural verb
oh: समूहवाचक संज्ञा को एक इकाई माना गया है
e: When a collective noun is viewed as one unit, singular agreement is standard; the pronoun “its” reinforces that reading.
eh: जब समूहवाचक संज्ञा को एक इकाई माना जाता है, तो एकवचन क्रिया मानक है; “its” भी इसी अर्थ की पुष्टि करता है।
oe: The collective noun is treated as a single body
The tense requires a plural verb

qe: Read: “The village library opened at dawn. Before school, children borrowed storybooks and returned them the next day.” What habit does the passage describe?
qh: पढ़िए: “The village library opened at dawn. Before school, children borrowed storybooks and returned them the next day.” अनुच्छेद किस आदत का वर्णन करता है?
o: Regular borrowing and returning of books
oh: किताबें नियमित रूप से लेना और लौटाना
विद्यालय से पहले पुस्तकालय बंद करना
e: The children borrow books before school and return them the next day, showing a regular library-use habit.
eh: बच्चे विद्यालय से पहले किताबें लेते हैं और अगले दिन लौटाते हैं; यह पुस्तकालय के नियमित उपयोग की आदत है।
oe: Regular borrowing and returning of books

qe: Choose the correct completion: “By the time the guests arrived, the host ___ dinner.”
qh: सही रूप चुनिए: “By the time the guests arrived, the host ___ dinner.”
e: The preparation was completed before another past event, so past perfect is used.
eh: भोजन की तैयारी दूसरी भूतकालीन घटना से पहले पूरी हो चुकी थी, इसलिए past perfect है।

qe: Choose the correctly parallel construction.
qh: समानांतर रचना वाला सही वाक्य चुनिए।
o: She enjoys reading, writing and painting.
She enjoys reading, to write and painting.
She enjoys to read, writing and to paint.
She enjoys read, write and painting.
She enjoys reading, write and to paint.
oe: She enjoys reading, writing and painting.
She enjoys reading, to write and painting.
She enjoys to read, writing and to paint.
She enjoys read, write and painting.
She enjoys reading, write and to paint.
oh: उसे पढ़ना, लिखना और चित्र बनाना पसंद है।
उसे पढ़ना, लिखने और चित्र बनाना पसंद है।
उसे पढ़ने, लिखना और चित्र बनाने पसंद है।
उसे पढ़, लिख और चित्र बनाना पसंद है।
उसे पढ़ना, लिखना और चित्र बनाना पसंद है।
e: The three items use the same grammatical form: gerunds ending in -ing.
eh: तीनों पद एक ही व्याकरणिक रूप—ing वाले gerund—में हैं।

qe: Choose the correct sentence using “despite.”
qh: “Despite” का सही प्रयोग करने वाला वाक्य चुनिए।
o: Despite the heavy rain, the match continued.
Despite it was raining, the match continued.
Despite of the rain, the match continued.
Despite the rain was heavy, match continued.
Despite to rain, the match continued.
oe: Despite the heavy rain, the match continued.
Despite it was raining, the match continued.
Despite of the rain, the match continued.
Despite the rain was heavy, match continued.
Despite to rain, the match continued.
oh: भारी वर्षा के बावजूद मैच जारी रहा।
हालाँकि बारिश हो रही थी, मैच जारी रहा।
बारिश के बावजूद (गलत संरचना) मैच जारी रहा।
वर्षा भारी थी बावजूद मैच जारी रहा।
बारिश होने के बावजूद मैच जारी रहा।
e: “Despite” is followed by a noun phrase or gerund, not a full clause introduced by “it was.”
eh: “Despite” के बाद संज्ञा-पदबंध या gerund आता है, “it was” वाला पूरा उपवाक्य नहीं।

qe: Choose the correct form: “If I ___ the principal, I would extend the library hours.”
qh: सही रूप चुनिए: “If I ___ the principal, I would extend the library hours.”
e: The second conditional conventionally uses “were” in the hypothetical if-clause.
eh: काल्पनिक second conditional में if-clause में परंपरागत रूप से “were” आता है।

qe: In “The novel that won the award was translated into Hindi,” which clause modifies “novel”?
qh: “The novel that won the award was translated into Hindi” में कौन-सा उपवाक्य “novel” का वर्णन करता है?
e: “That won the award” is a relative clause describing “novel.”
eh: “That won the award” उपन्यास का वर्णन करने वाला संबंधवाचक उपवाक्य है।

qe: Choose the correct passive form: “The committee has approved the proposal.”
qh: सही कर्मवाच्य चुनिए: “The committee has approved the proposal.”
o: The proposal has been approved by the committee.
The proposal was approve by the committee.
The committee has been approved the proposal.
The proposal has approved by committee.
The proposal is approving by the committee.
oe: The proposal has been approved by the committee.
The proposal was approve by the committee.
The committee has been approved the proposal.
The proposal has approved by committee.
The proposal is approving by the committee.
oh: प्रस्ताव समिति द्वारा स्वीकृत किया गया है।
प्रस्ताव ने समिति स्वीकृत की है।
प्रस्ताव समिति द्वारा स्वीकृत कर रहा है।
e: Present perfect passive uses “has/have been” plus the past participle.
eh: Present perfect कर्मवाच्य में “has/have been” के बाद past participle आता है।

qe: Choose the correct indirect question.
qh: सही अप्रत्यक्ष प्रश्न चुनिए।
o: Could you tell me where the station is?
Could you tell me where is the station?
Could you tell me where was the station is?
Could you tell me that where is station?
Could you tell where the station does?
oe: Could you tell me where the station is?
Could you tell me where is the station?
Could you tell me where was the station is?
Could you tell me that where is station?
Could you tell where the station does?
oh: क्या आप बता सकते हैं कि स्टेशन कहाँ है?
क्या आप बता सकते हैं स्टेशन कहाँ है?
क्या आप बता सकते हैं स्टेशन कहाँ था है?
क्या आप बता सकते हैं कि कहाँ स्टेशन है?
क्या आप बता सकते हैं स्टेशन कहाँ करता है?
e: An indirect question uses statement word order: subject before verb (“the station is”).
eh: अप्रत्यक्ष प्रश्न में कथन का क्रम होता है: कर्ता क्रिया से पहले (“the station is”).

qe: Choose the correct quantifier: “There is ___ water left in the bottle, enough for one glass.”
qh: सही परिमाणवाचक चुनिए: “There is ___ water left in the bottle, enough for one glass.”
e: “Water” is uncountable; “a little” means a small amount.
eh: “Water” अगणनीय है; “a little” का अर्थ थोड़ी मात्रा है।

qe: Which revision corrects the comma splice? “The bell rang, the students left the room.”
qh: वाक्य के comma splice को कौन-सा संशोधन ठीक करता है? “The bell rang, the students left the room.”
o: The bell rang, and the students left the room.
The bell rang the, students left the room.
The bell, rang the students left the room.
The bell rang, because the students left the room.
The bell rang, the students, left the room.
oe: The bell rang, and the students left the room.
The bell rang the, students left the room.
The bell, rang the students left the room.
The bell rang, because the students left the room.
The bell rang, the students, left the room.
oh: घंटी बजी और विद्यार्थी कमरे से बाहर चले गए।
घंटी बजी विद्यार्थी, कमरे से बाहर चले गए।
घंटी, बजी विद्यार्थी बाहर चले गए।
घंटी बजी क्योंकि विद्यार्थी चले गए।
घंटी बजी, विद्यार्थी, बाहर चले गए।
e: Two independent clauses can be joined with a comma and coordinating conjunction, or separated by a full stop.
eh: दो स्वतंत्र उपवाक्य comma और समन्वयकारी संयोजक से जुड़ सकते हैं, या पूर्णविराम से अलग किए जा सकते हैं।

qe: Choose the antonym of “meticulous.”
qh: “Meticulous” का विलोम चुनिए।
e: “Meticulous” means very careful and precise; “careless” is its opposite.
eh: “Meticulous” का अर्थ बहुत सावधान और सटीक है; “careless” इसका विलोम है।

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning to “resilient.”
qh: “Resilient” के सबसे निकट अर्थ वाला शब्द चुनिए।
oh: कठिनाई के बाद उबरने में सक्षम
e: A resilient person or system can recover or adapt after difficulty.
eh: Resilient व्यक्ति या व्यवस्था कठिनाई के बाद उबर या अनुकूलित हो सकती है।

qe: What does the phrasal verb “turn down” mean in “She turned down the offer”?
qh: “She turned down the offer” में “turn down” का क्या अर्थ है?
e: “Turn down” means to refuse an offer or request.
eh: “Turn down” का अर्थ प्रस्ताव या अनुरोध अस्वीकार करना है।

qe: What does the idiom “once in a blue moon” mean?
qh: मुहावरे “once in a blue moon” का क्या अर्थ है?
e: The idiom describes something that happens very rarely.
eh: यह मुहावरा किसी बहुत दुर्लभ घटना के लिए है।

qe: Which sentence uses a gerund as its subject?
qh: किस वाक्य में gerund कर्ता के रूप में है?
e: “Swimming” is an -ing form functioning as the subject of the sentence.
eh: “Swimming” यहाँ -ing रूप है जो वाक्य के कर्ता का काम कर रहा है।

qe: Read: “The report used figures from three years and explained where the data came from. The writer also listed uncertainties.” What made the report more transparent?
qh: पढ़िए: “रिपोर्ट ने तीन वर्षों के आँकड़े लिए और बताया कि डेटा कहाँ से आया। लेखक ने अनिश्चितताएँ भी सूचीबद्ध कीं।” रिपोर्ट अधिक पारदर्शी किस बात से बनी?
o: It identified sources and acknowledged uncertainty
It used only one unexplained figure
It made a claim without evidence
oe: It identified sources and acknowledged uncertainty
It used only one unexplained figure
It made a claim without evidence
oh: उसने स्रोत बताए और अनिश्चितता स्वीकार की
उसने बिना समझाए एक आँकड़ा दिया
e: Naming sources and stating limitations let readers examine how the conclusion was reached.
eh: स्रोत और सीमाएँ बताने से पाठक निष्कर्ष तक पहुँचने का तरीका जाँच सकते हैं।
